enchantments.tooltip: Psychic Ward: This items wards you against mind-altering effects and spells, such as Charm and Domination.
Good Luck +2: This item gives a +2 Luck bonus to all saves and skill checks.
Reflex Save +6: This item gives a +6 Resistance bonus to your Reflex saves.
Quality Alluring Skills Bonus: +3 Quality bonus to Bluff, Diplomacy, Haggle, Intimidate, and Perform.
